question: How do the fixed-center proximity gate and shared latch start, attenuate and stop audio?

semantics.gate: Pianist inactive bit inhibits. Otherwise subtract fixed (840,168) in WORDs, negate negative WORDs, sum in a WORD and compare unsigned with 256. $8000 negates to itself; two $8000 magnitudes wrap to zero and enter near.
semantics.entry: Interaction bit 0 starts audio mode 2 only on its clear-to-set edge. The near entry saves D0/D1/A6 around real initialization; repeated visits avoid it.
semantics.attenuation: For wrapped distance 0..255, store master-volume WORD 64-floor(distance/4), range 64..1.
semantics.exit: Distance exit resets only if active and stores WORD $0040. Actor inhibition resets only if active, but its BYTE store at the WORD address changes only the high byte, yielding $40xx. Inactive exits preserve the volume. No behavioral repair is made.
semantics.shared_start: Sets the same latch and initializes mode 2 only once, saving D1-D7/A1-A6. Final MOVE.W clears carry; active visits retain D0, real mode-2 initialization returns D0=28 in the checked original records.
